title: Yummy Indulgent Ethiopian Pancake Tibs
description: A buttery, crumbly pancake infused with Ethiopian spices, folded around a savory bhuna filling, served on an agave leaf for an indulgent low-calorie treat.
instructions: Whisk together rice flour, all-purpose flour, salt, berbere, and cardamom until dry mix is uniform.
Create a well in the center and crack the egg; add milk, melted butter, and whisk until smooth batter forms.

Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat, drizzle a teaspoon of olive oil, pour a thin layer of batter to form a small pancake; cook until edges lift then flip and cook until golden, about 1 minute per side.
Repeat with remaining batter to make 8 pancakes, keeping them warm.
In a separate pan, heat a tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat and sauté diced onions, garlic, and a pinch of berbere until fragrant.
Add sliced bell peppers and lean protein such as tofu or chicken breast, cooking until browned and cooked through.
Stir in a splash of low-fat milk to deglaze, then reduce heat and let the mixture simmer until thickened slightly, about 4 minutes.
Spoon a generous portion of the bhuna filling onto the center of each pancake.
Fold the pancake halves over the filling and serve immediately on warm agave leaf.
Optional: garnish with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lemon juice for brightness.
